gen-gf-gugi-gf-anek-tamil: Gugi draws its round bowls with one unvarying outline, and its lowercase climbs close to the capitals. Anek Tamil has big round bowls and curves left half unwrapped, which lets paragraphs of text flow along without snagging.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-anek-telugu: Distinctive from the first glance, Gugi keeps every curve as consistent as a compass-drawn line, with its terminals cut open. Anek Telugu adds wide bowls and unlatched-hook rounds that give each line room.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-anuphan: Cut-open and confident: Gugi builds its capitals from lines of one constant thickness. And where Gugi makes a statement, Anuphan simply reads, with big round bowls and clear gaps in its curves.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-arimo: Pipe-cleaner letterforms with open-cut terminals give Gugi its whole look, and its lowercase nearly reaches the capitals. Arimo's plain sans shapes, with a high mean line, steady the page.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-armata: Thin hairline joins? Gone; Gugi connects strokes at full width. Armata's generous spacing and full-bodied lowercase supply the pair's standout quality: easy, open reading beneath a loud, distinctive heading.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-athiti: Contemporary and friendly, Athiti keeps a sign-shop single-width line beside Gugi's cut-open terminals. Its mean line sits high and each s shows a see-through gap, so a full page of text moves along easily.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-mon: Distinctive and bold, Gugi runs its stencil-flat lines against Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono. What the pair does best is let space in: the mono's counters breathe and its spacing stretches wide, under a flat-lined heading.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-blinker: Loud, open-ended letters: Gugi's lowercase nearly reaches its capitals, with curves matching the stems. Blinker then holds its lines at steady thickness, with readable open apertures and lowercase filling most of the height.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-carrois-gothic: Distinctive from its first stroke, Gugi looks drawn with constant pen pressure. Carrois Gothic brings a generous opening in c and a high-set x-height, a modern footing for body text.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Single-width strokes and open-cut terminals make Gugi look bold and unmistakable. Carrois Gothic SC sits quietly next to it, with clear openings on every curve and capitals and lowercase nearly matched in height.
